mapper.insert: insert into book_paragraph_comment (book_id, book_index_id, paragraph_idx, root_id, reply_user_name, comment_content, location, create_user_id, create_time) values (#{bookId}, #{bookIndexId}, #{paragraphIdx}, #{rootId}, #{replyUserName}, #{commentContent}, #{location}, #{createUserId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, t2.username create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo from book_paragraph_comment t1 inner join user t2 on t1.create_user_id = t2.id where t1.book_index_id = #{bookIndexId} and t1.paragraph_idx = #{paragraphIdx} order by t1.create_time asc limit 200

select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, t2.username create_user_name, t2.user_photo create_user_photo from book_paragraph_comment t1 inner join user t2 on t1.create_user_id = t2.id where t1.id = #{id}

select t1.id, t1.book_id, t1.book_index_id, t1.paragraph_idx, t1.root_id, t1.reply_user_name, t1.reply_count, t1.comment_content, t1.location, t1.create_user_id, t1.create_time, t2.book_name, t2.pic_url, t3.index_name from book_paragraph_comment t1 left join book t2 on t1.book_id = t2.id left join book_index t3 on t1.book_index_id = t3.id where t1.create_user_id = #{userId} order by t1.create_time desc
select paragraph_idx as idx, count(1) as num from book_paragraph_comment where book_index_id = #{bookIndexId} group by paragraph_idx
